lines.text: Many learners say: My phone is different with yours.
Better: My phone is different from yours.
From! My bag is different from yours.

data.wrong: My phone is different with yours.
data.right: My phone is different from yours.
data.memory: My phone is different from yours.

native.tip: Kita bilang “berbeda dengan punyamu”. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah different pakai from, bukan with.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “My phone is different with yours.” 😅 Setelah different, pakai from: “My phone is different from yours.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “from”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “My phone is different from yours.” lalu tulis dua hal yang berbeda. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “berbeda dengan punyamu”. In English, after different use from, not with.
en.caption: Ever say this? “My phone is different with yours.” 😅 After different, use from: “My phone is different from yours.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
